create_sampler: create a Griffin model sampler with greedy or categorical sampling and a SentencePiece vocabulary
run_sampler_call: run the sampler to generate text completions from input strings with configurable generation steps
sample_from_logits: sample next tokens from model logits using greedy argmax or categorical distribution
tokenize_input: tokenize an input string into a tensor of token IDs with BOS prefix using SentencePiece
process_prompt_prefill: pre-process batched prompt tokens and initialize the sampling state with cache and buffers
